queries.cypher: MATCH (d:Decision {id: $id}) OPTIONAL MATCH (n:Decision)-[su:SUPERSEDES]->(d) WHERE su.at <= $as_of AND coalesce(su.stated, su.at) <= $as_of OPTIONAL MATCH (x:Evidence)-[rt:RETIRES]->(d) WHERE rt.at <= $as_of AND coalesce(rt.stated, rt.at) <= $as_of OPTIONAL MATCH (d)-[:RECORDED_IN]->(src:Evidence) OPTIONAL MATCH (d)-[:GOVERNS]->(s:System) RETURN d, n.id, n.title, su.at, x.id, x.title, rt.at, rt.quote, src, collect(DISTINCT s.name)

MATCH (d:Decision {id: $id}) MATCH p = (d)-[:BECAUSE_OF|DERIVED_FROM*1..4]->(pr:Premise) OPTIONAL MATCH (e)-[r:SUPPORTS|CONTRADICTS]->(pr) WHERE r.at <= $as_of AND coalesce(r.stated, r.at) <= $as_of OPTIONAL MATCH (a:Person)-[:AUTHORED]->(e) RETURN pr, nodes(p) AS pn, length(p) AS hops, collect({id: e.id, title: e.title, kind: e.kind, date: e.date, rel: type(r), at: r.at, stated: r.stated, quote: r.quote, author: a.name}) ORDER BY hops

MATCH (p:Person)-[o:OWNS]->(d:Decision) WHERE o.valid_from <= $as_of AND ($id IS NULL OR d.id = $id) RETURN d.id, p.id, p.name, p.role, o.valid_from, o.valid_to, o.handed_over_from ORDER BY d.id, o.valid_from
MATCH (f:Finding)-[:ABOUT]->(d:Decision {id: $id}) OPTIONAL MATCH (f)-[:SUPERSEDED_BY]->(n:Finding) OPTIONAL MATCH (f)-[:ASSIGNED_TO]->(p:Person) RETURN f, n.id, p.name ORDER BY f.created_at DESC

MATCH (d:Decision {id: $id}) OPTIONAL MATCH (n:Decision)-[su:SUPERSEDES]->(d) WHERE su.at <= $as_of AND coalesce(su.stated, su.at) <= $as_of OPTIONAL MATCH (x:Evidence)-[rt:RETIRES]->(d) WHERE rt.at <= $as_of AND coalesce(rt.stated, rt.at) <= $as_of OPTIONAL MATCH (d)-[:RECORDED_IN]->(src:Evidence) OPTIONAL MATCH (d)-[:GOVERNS]->(s:System) RETURN d, n.id, n.title, su.at, x.id, x.title, rt.at, rt.quote, src, collect(DISTINCT s.name)

MATCH (d:Decision {id: $id}) MATCH p = (d)-[:BECAUSE_OF|DERIVED_FROM*1..6]->(pr:Premise) OPTIONAL MATCH (e)-[r:SUPPORTS|CONTRADICTS]->(pr) WHERE r.at <= $as_of AND coalesce(r.stated, r.at) <= $as_of OPTIONAL MATCH (a:Person)-[:AUTHORED]->(e) RETURN pr, nodes(p) AS pn, length(p) AS hops, collect({id: e.id, title: e.title, kind: e.kind, date: e.date, rel: type(r), at: r.at, stated: r.stated, quote: r.quote, author: a.name}) ORDER BY hops

MATCH (p:Person)-[o:OWNS]->(d:Decision) WHERE o.valid_from <= $as_of AND ($id IS NULL OR d.id = $id) RETURN d.id, p.id, p.name, p.role, o.valid_from, o.valid_to, o.handed_over_from ORDER BY d.id, o.valid_from
MATCH (d:Decision) WITH count(d) AS n OPTIONAL MATCH ()-[e:SUPPORTS|CONTRADICTS]->(:Premise) RETURN n, count(e)

MATCH (d:Decision {id: $id}) OPTIONAL MATCH (x)-[rt:SUPERSEDES|RETIRES]->(d) WITH d, collect([x.id, type(rt), properties(rt)]) AS ret OPTIONAL MATCH (o:Person)-[w:OWNS]->(d) WITH d, ret, collect([o.id, o.left, properties(w)]) AS own OPTIONAL MATCH p = (d)-[:BECAUSE_OF|DERIVED_FROM*1..6]->(pr:Premise) OPTIONAL MATCH (e)-[r:SUPPORTS|CONTRADICTS]->(pr) RETURN properties(d), ret, own, [n IN nodes(p) | n.id], properties(pr), collect([e.id, e.kind, type(r), properties(r)])
